caseData.headline: Likely: invoices are fake, inflated or altered

findings.plain: invoices are fake, inflated or altered

signals.explanation: 108 invoice numbers were submitted more than once with different amounts (up to 25.0x the original)
Reported receivables are 9.4x their usual size relative to revenue (2 quarters in a row): money is booked that isn't being collected
5 of 15 invoice documents show a different total from the borrower's data (read twice by the document model)
119 invoices are over 5x what the named customer normally pays
15.4% of invoices past due were never paid by the named customer (124 of 803)
Reported receivables include invoices that S4 found altered, unpaid or implausible
Not enrolled in Setpoint PledgeCheck: whether this collateral is also pledged at other lenders can't be verified
